name: b5_400m_win_v3
lr_schedule: linear warm-up 5% of total steps, then linear decay
checkpoint_rule: minimum mean validation loss; patience 3 epochs; compare loss to loss (not perplexity)
notes: New-version recipe (protocol A26, 2026-09-02): genome tiles of 30,720 / 61,440 / 129,024 nt labelled with every complete gene (GSF v3: gene blocks joined by <gene>, <empty> for windows without a complete gene). Same architecture/optimisation as the published 400M recipe except vocab 290, decoder positions and label cap 8,192 (tile statistics: 38 % of A. thaliana 129-kb tiles exceed 4,096 tokens), encoder input up to 129,024 nt. All seeds on NSF ACCESS (A25).
